narrative: This structural split of DemoStore drew 51 findings over 5 rounds, mostly real pre-existing issues surfaced by the new module boundaries, so every round had independent findings and none was purely avoidable. The costliest fix was F29: the agent accepted a re-entrancy guard on installSubscriptions that contradicted its own correct F9 pushback, and five round-3 findings then reported the dropped-reconnect bug it caused before 8119609 reverted it. Three other fixes were partial: F3 tested one of two helpers, F11 logged only the thrown path, and F15 commented instead of renaming. Pushbacks on MobX runInAction (F28, F41, F42, F44, F45) and session_attached parsing (F22, F33) were correct, the former checked with a strict-mode probe.
guidance_observations: Before accepting a finding, check it against your own earlier replies on the same code path; F29 reversed F9's correct reasoning and cost a round of five findings.
Pushbacks that leave no code comment (F22, F17) were re-raised one and two rounds later; recording the reason in code the first time ends the loop.
The trust-boundary stance (no defensive parsing of malformed tmux rows) was applied at F2/F5 and then dropped at F48/F49, so the same class of finding got opposite answers in one PR.
The agent reversed itself on F1/F25 (`|| 80`), so a pushback it did not actually hold ended in the change it had argued against.
